mission.title: Static
mission.description: Track Mauser's signal for a proximity scan to pinpoint his broadcast source.

npc.say: Goddammit! Can we get a trace?
There are factors beyond your control.
Have to try to deal with this interference somehow... Re-establish contact...
Security breach! Please take cover, Mr. Cleveland.
You can be sure that we will be investigating these avenues with all due diligence.

Our opponents were able to benefit from the element of surprise. This will not work a second time. If Mauser attempts to re-enter the simulation, he will be detected, isolated, and terminated.
If you are fortunate, you will be assigned to that duty, {player}. You would relish that distinction, yes?

phase.briefing:
Despite increased storm activity caused by a Merovingian seeding operation, operative teams working on foot, and other data sources, have enabled us to narrow the search for Mauser's broadcast source to a relatively small area. A close range scan of his simulated self-image should provide us with the data we require to pinpoint his broadcast point.
Proceed to the point where his signal has been detected in the Matrix, and search for the target. You are to maintain position for a proximity scan. You are not to damage him; his signal must remain intact until we have locked its source.

enter.say: Got a hint of his signal in there, but it looks to me like it's only residual... I'm picking up other signals, probably redpills.

done.say: Another restricted line. Nothing's working on it... Maybe the Machines can pick up something.

phase.briefing: We have achieved a correlation between a signal reading and a suspected pirate phone terminal. Pursue the signal, {player}.

enter.say: Got something... Hold on. Yeah... Yeah, it's the signal! Get in there!

done.say: That should do it. I'm starting the scan... Stay close to him.

talk.say: Operative, scan control reports a problem. Abort and proceed immediately to the operations room.

near.say: Cut that line before he gets away!

phase.briefing:
Hm. You've moved away, but the problem remains.
Report to the operations room, operative. There has been interference with the scan of Mauser. We will need to run a diagnostic on your instantiation.

enter.say: Man, everything's checking out here. I don't think the problem was on our end.

talk.say:
My word! This must have been the source of the interference. Yes... Broadcast from inside the simulation... We've seen this pattern before. It was thought to have been removed!
The interference has climbed too rapidly... We're losing the target signal!

near.say: What th-- Some kind of broadcast coming through! What... Is that what I think it is?
Security breach! Please take cover, Mr. Cleveland.

phase.briefing:
I am told now that the interference has ceased, but no sign remains of Mauser's signal. His broadcast location cannot be pinpointed.
This merits further discussion. Please meet me at the location shown, operative.

enter.say:
Well...this sucks.
So wha-- Was that the Morpheus simulacrum, or what?

talk.say:
Our data indicates that the source of the interference was a broadcast type identical to that used in the past by the Morpheus simulacrum.
This is the first known connection between the simulacrum and Mauser. The simulacrum had been completely inactive within the simulation since the Oracle's termination. When we consider that Mauser is likely to have access to technology developed by Danielle Wright, and that the Morpheus simulacrum's activity prior to its disappearance was linked to that of the Oracle, and that all four of these parties have provided significant assistance to Zion in the past, the possibility of a serious threat to the simulation emerges.

mission.finish: Detection of threats is the first step in their elimination. Your efforts in this direction have continued to ensure the simulation's uninterrupted operation, {player}. The System appreciates your service.
